text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED: smart-routing fallback loop causing tool_call failures and 5xxs for some requests. auto-triggered by 5xx-rate > 3% in ap-southeast. Thread root: 1902345678
sasha-oncall: seeing spikes in error rate + customer reports about tool integrations failing. Pagered. I'm on it. First triage: seems correlated with region fallback to cheaper quant variants.
alex-runtime: confirmed. grep from router logs:
```
[1902345679] route_decision: request_id=... policy=sr-policy-42 -> region=ap-southeast
[1902345680] model_pick: candidate=redwood/llama-13b-fp16 -> unavailable in region
[1902345681] fallback -> candidate=redwood/llama-13b-8bit-q4
[1902345682] runtime_error: tool_call not supported by model_variant
[1902345683] fallback_loop_detected: retrying -> picks same quant variant in another region -> same error
```
alex-runtime: root cause guess: model-compatibility matrix doesn't mark q4 variants as "tool_call_support": true. Router fallback logic tries region fallback and doesn't filter by tool_call capability.
mira-mlinfra: adding to this — we just onboarded an 8-bit quant family and the metadata ingest script omitted the tools metadata field for those artifacts. Likely a one-line bug in the upload pipeline.
sam-support: impacted customers: 3 enterprise orgs (ACME, Finori, HealthNet) reporting integrations failing (webhooks and tool calls). Support ticket numbers: #5642, #5647, #5651. Severity elevated. Customers seeing 500s for tool-enabled endpoints.
sasha-oncall: immediate mitigation: 1) disable region fallback in sr-policy-42 2) add temporary route rule to pin tool_call routes to fp16 variants 3) global 429/slowdown throttling for low-cost variants to avoid loop. I'll run the changes now.
deploy-bot: change_request 4578 queued by sasha-oncall
deploy-bot: apply change sr-policy-42: set allow_region_fallback=false
deploy-bot: apply change route-overlay: tool_call_routes -> model_selector(require_tool_support=true)
deploy-bot: rollout completed (gradual, 2m)
sasha-oncall: mitigation in place. Error rate dropped from 3.4% -> 0.6% in 7m. Tool failures reduced. Continuing monitoring.
carol-cs: looping in CS to proactively message ACME/Finori/HealthNet with ETA and workaround. Jordan can you draft customer note?
jordan-product: will draft now. Key points: root cause, mitigation, short-term workaround (pin to hosted fp16), ETA for full fix (3 hours) and offer direct line for support. cc @carol-cs
mira-mlinfra: working on permanent fix — patching metadata ingest to preserve tool_call capability and run a rescan of quant-family artifacts. Plan: deploy patch + backfill metadata + force router to refresh compatibility cache. ETA ~ 2h.
alex-runtime: also going to add guard in router: require compatibility check before region fallback. I'll open PR and request quick review.
alex-runtime: PR #8293 opened -> router: check model_variant.capabilities.tool_call before considering as fallback. Tests added.
sasha-oncall: handing off to mira and jordan for next 2h watch. I'm going offline for rotation at +30m. Paging mira and jordan as primary.
sasha-oncall: :arrow_right: Handoff to @mira-mlinfra and @jordan-product. Please ack.
mira-mlinfra: ack. taking lead. will post updates here when metadata backfill completes.
jordan-product: ack. prepping customer comms. will coordinate with carol.
carol-cs: ACME CSM notified, sent short workaround. They want a conference call if outages persist.
deploy-bot: deploy status: metadata-patch v1.0 -> staged -> canary pass -> promoted
mira-mlinfra: metadata backfill finished for quant family. Router cache refresh issued.
alex-runtime: router guard merged and deployed (hotfix). Observability: no further loop traces. Tool_call errors back to baseline.
sasha-oncall: verified impact metrics: ACME error rate back to normal, other customers recovering. Closing pager, marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
sasha-oncall: action items assigned: mira -> postmortem + root cause + deployment to prod for backfill (due EOD). alex-runtime -> router guard hardening + unit tests (PR linked). jordan -> customer communication + follow-up. sam-support -> confirm closed tickets. carol-cs -> follow up with ACME and confirm SLA credits if needed.
jordan-product: draft sent to ACME/Finori/HealthNet, waiting replies. Will post final copy to #customer-comms.
sam-support: all three customer tickets updated and set to monitoring. No new reports in last 30m.
mira-mlinfra: postmortem draft in progress, will include timeline, root cause (metadata ingestion bug), short-term mitigations, long-term fix (ingest validation + compatibility contract tests), and monitoring additions.
incidents-bot: Incident resolved. Severity: Sev2 -> downgraded to Sev3. Postmortem required. Tags: model-matrix, routing, quantization, tool-calling
sasha-oncall: thanks team. great fast work. closing thread in 1h unless any regressions.
